exact_locators.locator: Materials and Methods > Study Locale and Population
exact_locators.supports: The study was conducted in Khunti district; Murhu and Torpa blocks were purposively selected; qualitative enquiries were conducted in nine villages.
Cross-sectional mixed-method design; data collection occurred June 2019-January 2020.

Nine focus-group discussions and six key-informant interviews were conducted; free-listing and other elicitation addressed indigenous foods and related knowledge; local field workers fluent in Mundari supported qualitative enquiries.

Institutional ethics approvals are reported; district/cluster administrative permissions are reported; literate respondents provided written informed consent and illiterate respondents third-party-witnessed verbal consent; participants were informed that discussions/interviews were recorded.
The article states that original contributions are included in the article/supplementary material and further inquiries may be directed to the corresponding authors.
Article is distributed under Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY), with attribution conditions.
